summary: All 161 in-scope files across the iOS app, React SPA, and legacy static tree were reviewed against all 7 categories, producing 52 findings (4 Critical, 16 High, 19 Medium, 13 Low). The iOS app is comparatively mature (no Critical/High iOS-guideline gaps, clear evidence of prior remediation), while the React web app and legacy static tree carry the bulk of the Critical/High findings, including two independent stored-XSS vectors, a cross-account private-message cache leak, a silently-failing call-join flow, and a billing action that can report false success — this is not a clean codebase right now, with a recurring pattern of fixes applied in one place but not to sibling implementations or neighboring call sites.
